article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Indica-leaning hybrid
Genetics: Banana Cream Pop #13 × Jokerz #31
Breeder: Compound Genetics
THC Content: 27–30%
CBD Content: Typically low
Terpene Profile: N/A
Primary Flavors: Artificial banana, fuel, sweet candy, earth
Flowering Time (Indoor): 8–9 weeks
Outdoor Harvest Time: late September / early October
Indoor Yield: High
Outdoor Yield: High
Grow Difficulty: Moderate

Some marijuana strains reveal exactly what they are the moment the jar opens, but Inside Joke is more unpredictable. One plant may fill the room with artificial banana candy and gasoline, while another can push toward herbs, peppery spice, sweet earth, or a darker fuel profile. Compound Genetics deliberately embraced that variability when combining Banana Cream Pop #13 with Jokerz #31. The common thread is gas: nearly every phenotype examined during the breeder’s selection work retained a noticeable fuel component, even when the sweeter or more unusual aromas changed considerably from plant to plant.

That diversity gives the cultivar unusual depth for a modern high-potency hybrid. Dense green flowers are most common, although purple expressions also occur, and heavy trichome production gives mature buds an almost glazed appearance. Plants stretch moderately, stack flowers tightly along the branches, and can produce substantial yields within an 8–9-week flowering period. Inside Joke therefore offers more than unusual banana terpenes—it combines distinctive flavor hunting with the production traits, resin coverage, potency, and visual quality associated with Compound Genetics’ Jokerz #31 breeding program.
Genetics and Lineage

Inside Joke is the direct offspring of Banana Cream Pop #13 and Jokerz #31. Banana Cream Pop #13 comes from Private Banana crossed with Gastro Pop #5, giving the mother side of the pedigree a particularly fruit-heavy and gas-oriented background. Gastro Pop #5 itself descends from Apples and Bananas × Grape Gasoline , two lines that helped establish Compound Genetics’ reputation for combining saturated fruit terpenes with strong fuel. The selected Banana Cream Pop #13 plant brought something even more unusual to the project: a distinctive artificial-banana aroma reminiscent of banana candy rather than ripe fresh fruit.

Jokerz #31 supplies the second half of the cross and is one of Compound Genetics’ most important selected breeding plants. Jokerz was created from White Runtz × Jet Fuel Gelato , pairing the sweet candy characteristics of Runtz genetics with the powerful fuel and dessert profile associated with Jet Fuel Gelato. Compound evaluated a large population of Jokerz plants before retaining phenotype #31 for its aroma, smooth smoke, flower quality, color, resin density, and overall performance. The clone subsequently underwent extensive testing and stabilization before becoming a parent in an entire collection of Jokerz #31 hybrids.

The resulting family tree explains Inside Joke’s broad sensory range. Banana Cream Pop can contribute tropical candy, artificial banana, fruit, and gas, while Jokerz #31 reinforces fuel and adds sweetness, floral complexity, resin, and modern potency. Compound Genetics observed considerable phenotype variation within the cross, which means seed-grown plants should not be expected to express a perfectly uniform aroma. Structurally, however, the line is more consistent: medium stretch, tight internodal spacing, heavy flower formation, and strong production appear repeatedly across selections.
Effects and Experience

Inside Joke tends to develop in stages rather than immediately dropping the consumer into a heavy body stone. The opening can feel bright, euphoric, and mentally animated, with an increased interest in conversation, music, entertainment, or creative activities. Mood may rise quickly, and the cerebral component can initially feel surprisingly lively for an indica-leaning hybrid. That early energy gives the strain more versatility than its dense flowers and powerful cannabinoid levels might suggest.

As the experience matures, physical relaxation gradually becomes more noticeable. Tension can begin to fade through the shoulders and limbs while the earlier mental enthusiasm settles into a calmer, more contented state. Moderate servings may remain social and functional, but stronger amounts can create a much heavier finish in which sitting still becomes increasingly appealing. Appetite can also emerge during this later stage, particularly after substantial doses.

Potency is one of the cultivar’s defining traits. Examples of the line are commonly associated with THC levels in the upper-20% range and can move beyond 30% under favorable conditions, making restraint sensible for people with limited tolerance. Excessive intake may produce dry mouth, dry eyes, dizziness, racing thoughts, or temporary paranoia before the body-relaxing phase becomes dominant. Smaller servings preserve the contrast between the upbeat beginning and the slower physical finish more effectively than immediately consuming a large amount.
Medical Benefits

The combination of mood elevation and later physical calm may interest medical cannabis consumers seeking a high-potency hybrid that does not begin with immediate sedation. During the initial phase, the brighter mental shift can make stress, emotional fatigue, or low motivation feel less prominent. As the experience settles into the body, muscular tension and generalized discomfort may become easier to ignore without completely removing mental engagement.

A larger serving changes the balance. Relaxation becomes more substantial, appetite may increase, and the cultivar can become better suited to quiet evening use than daytime responsibilities. Some consumers therefore may prefer Inside Joke when they want marijuana that can bridge the period between being active and winding down. Those sensitive to strong THC should approach it cautiously, since high cannabinoid concentrations can intensify anxiety or impair short-term memory and coordination rather than producing the desired sense of calm.

Medical effects cannot be predicted solely from the name or pedigree because the seed line displays considerable chemical and aromatic variation. One plant may emphasize sweet banana and gas while another moves toward earth, herbs, or spice, suggesting meaningful differences in volatile compounds between phenotypes. Laboratory results from the actual batch provide a better basis for therapeutic decisions than assuming every Inside Joke flower shares identical cannabinoid and terpene chemistry.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

Artificial banana is the most unusual expression found within Inside Joke, and it can be striking when the trait appears strongly. Instead of natural banana flesh, the aroma can resemble banana taffy, candy flavoring, or an intensely sweet tropical confection. Fuel sits beneath it, adding a petroleum-like sharpness that prevents the sweetness from becoming one-dimensional. In the most expressive examples, opening a container can produce a rapid progression from candy to gas before earthy and spicy notes become apparent.

Not every phenotype follows that exact direction. Compound Genetics found substantial aromatic diversity during its hunt, with some plants leaning herbal, others spicy, and still others strongly sweet. Most retained at least some gas, creating a recognizable family resemblance even when the banana component weakened. Visually, this diversity appears as well: green flowers predominate, but purple individuals can emerge, particularly when Jokerz traits are expressed strongly.

Flavor usually follows the nose with a sweet opening and heavier fuel on the finish. Artificial banana can persist through vaporization especially well because lower temperatures preserve the lighter aromatic compounds, while combustion tends to emphasize gas, earth, and spice. A slow cure benefits the cultivar considerably. Flowers dried too quickly may lose the unusual candy top notes, leaving behind a more conventional earthy-fuel profile and obscuring one of the cross’s most desirable characteristics.
Growing Information

Inside Joke combines high production with a manageable growth pattern. Compound Genetics describes medium stretch and tight internodal spacing, meaning flowering sites form relatively close together while the plant still gains enough height after the light cycle changes to fill available space. Topping during vegetative growth can create several dominant branches, and low-stress training or a trellis allows those branches to spread horizontally before the buds begin gaining serious weight. Growers should avoid allowing the canopy to become excessively congested because the same tight spacing that supports heavy yields can restrict airflow inside dense plants.

Indoor flowering takes approximately 8–9 weeks. As maturity approaches, the flowers become increasingly resinous and can range from bright or deep green to purple depending on phenotype. High trichome density makes the line attractive for rosin, dry sift, and ice-water hash in addition to finished flower. Strong branches are valuable because productive plants can carry significant weight, and selective support may be useful during the final weeks. Maintaining moderate humidity and continuous airflow is particularly important once dense buds begin closing up.

Outdoor cultivation can produce substantial plants when full sunlight and unrestricted root space are available. Harvest timing varies with latitude and natural flowering onset, but an 8–9-week bloom generally places maturity from late September into October in many Northern Hemisphere gardens. Because Compound Genetics does not publish a universal grams-per-plant number, outdoor production is better judged by vigor and plant size than a fixed estimate. Phenotype hunters have an additional reason to grow multiple individuals: selecting the strongest artificial-banana expression while retaining tight structure, gas, resin density, and yield can reveal considerably more interesting keepers than choosing solely on harvest weight.
FAQ
What strains make Inside Joke?

Inside Joke was bred by Compound Genetics from Banana Cream Pop #13 × Jokerz #31. Banana Cream Pop #13 comes from Private Banana × Gastro Pop #5, while Jokerz #31 was selected from White Runtz × Jet Fuel Gelato.
Is Inside Joke indica or sativa?

Inside Joke is generally considered an indica-leaning hybrid. Its later effects can become deeply relaxing, although the beginning of the experience often feels more upbeat, euphoric, and mentally active than a traditional heavy indica.
What does Inside Joke taste like?

The breeder identifies fuel, artificial banana, earth, and spice as central characteristics. Individual plants vary considerably, with some leaning heavily into banana candy while others produce sweeter, more herbal, or spicier expressions. Gas remains common across most phenotypes.
How long does Inside Joke take to flower?

Compound Genetics lists an indoor flowering period of approximately 8–9 weeks. Outdoor harvest timing depends on climate and latitude but commonly falls from late September through October where the season allows the full flowering cycle to finish.
Is Inside Joke a high-yielding strain?

Yes. High yield is one of the breeder-listed traits. Plants combine medium stretch with tight internodal spacing, allowing flower sites to stack closely along the branches. Good canopy management, adequate lighting, airflow, and branch support can help growers take advantage of that productive architecture.
Final Thoughts on Inside Joke

Inside Joke stands apart because Compound Genetics did not force every plant into a single narrow flavor profile. Banana Cream Pop #13 introduces one of the more unusual modern cannabis aromas—artificial banana candy—while Jokerz #31 provides gas, sweetness, frost, and the dense premium flower structure expected from contemporary breeding. Some plants emphasize banana dramatically, whereas others explore herbs, spice, earth, or sweeter candy territory.

The effects show similar range. A bright and euphoric opening can make the cultivar surprisingly engaging at first, but substantial THC and Jokerz influence eventually create a calmer physical experience. That gradual transition gives moderate consumers a window of mental activity before the stronger body effects arrive, while heavier dosing reveals the more powerful indica-leaning side.

For growers, an 8–9-week flowering cycle, medium stretch, tight internodes, strong yields, and dense resin coverage create an attractive production package. The real opportunity, however, lies in selection. Finding a plant that combines the unusual banana-candy terpene with strong gas, heavy frost, manageable structure, and high flower quality can make Inside Joke far more memorable than its already impressive specifications suggest.
